name: Houkago no Ane ~Hakudaku Rinkan Ryoujoku no Wana ni Ochita Amemiya Mana
original_name: 放課後の姉　～白濁輪姦陵辱の罠に陥ちた　雨宮真名
source:
Mana Amamiya, the most beautiful girl in the entire school.
Her beauty is the envy of all her female classmates, and her large breasts are enough to excite all the boys with a single look!
However, her beauty and her large breasts were every day under constant assault from the teacher "Tatsuya Katsuragi".
It all started when her little brother "Jun" became a bullying target.
She consulted with Katsuragi on how to get her classmates to stop bullying her brother...
...but in order to help her, he wanted her body!

然而，她的美貌与巨乳每天都遭到教师葛城达也觊觎。一切都始于弟弟淳成为校园霸凌的目标。真名找葛城商量，希望他制止同学们欺负弟弟……可作为帮助她的条件，他索要的竟是她的身体！
